name: British Burnt Creams
subtitle: Silky vanilla custards with a crisp caramel topping
description: Bake vanilla custards until set, chill them thoroughly, then finish each with a thin layer of caramelized sugar.

ingredients.item: egg yolks (freeze the whites to use in another recipe)
caster sugar plus 8 tsp for the topping

instructions.text: Preheat the oven and arrange eight heatproof dishes in a deep baking pan.
Warm the vanilla pod, cream, and milk together until steaming and just simmering; remove from the heat.
Whisk the egg yolks with the caster sugar until smooth. Gradually whisk in the warm cream mixture.
Strain the custard into the dishes, then add enough hot water to the baking pan to come partway up their sides.
Bake until the centers are fully set and the custards reach 160°F, about 40 minutes.
Remove the dishes from the water bath, cool, and chill until cold, about 3 hours.
Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of the reserved topping sugar over each custard.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under a hot grill until deeply golden and set; serve once the topping hardens.
